SELECT
  a.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT s.synonym
     FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
     WHERE s.drugbank_id = a.parent_key
       AND LOWER(s.language) LIKE '%english%'
       AND (LOWER(s.coder) LIKE '%inn%' OR LOWER(s.coder) LIKE '%usan%')
     ORDER BY
       CASE WHEN LOWER(s.synonym) LIKE 'epoetin% alfa%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
       LENGTH(s.synonym)
     LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT s.synonym
     FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
     WHERE s.drugbank_id = a.parent_key
       AND LOWER(s.language) LIKE '%english%'
     ORDER BY LENGTH(s.synonym)
     LIMIT 1)
  ) AS drug_name
FROM
  (SELECT parent_key
   FROM "drugbank_drugs_attachments"
   WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%ema summary of product characteristics%'
     AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%retacrit%'
   GROUP BY parent_key
  ) a
JOIN
  (SELECT parent_key
   FROM (
     SELECT parent_key, title FROM "drugbank_drugs_attachments"
     UNION ALL
     SELECT parent_key, title FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
   )
   WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%fda%news release%'
     AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%epoetin alfa%'
     AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%biosimilar%'
   GROUP BY parent_key
  ) b
ON a.parent_key = b.parent_key
LIMIT 50;

WITH transport_action AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(known_action) AS action
  FROM "drugbank_transporters"
  WHERE known_action IS NOT NULL
    AND lower(known_action) IN ('substrate','transporter','transport','transported')
  ORDER BY CASE action
             WHEN 'substrate' THEN 0
             WHEN 'transporter' THEN 1
             WHEN 'transport' THEN 2
             ELSE 3
           END
  LIMIT 1
),
zinc_susp_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT n.name AS drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_dosages" d
  JOIN (
    SELECT left_drugbank_id AS id, left_drugbank_name AS name
    FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
    UNION
    SELECT right_drugbank_id AS id, right_drugbank_name AS name
    FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  ) n ON n.id = d.parent_key
  WHERE lower(d.form) LIKE '%suspension%'
    AND lower(n.name) LIKE '%zinc%'
)
SELECT 'transport_action_descriptor' AS item, action AS value
FROM transport_action
UNION ALL

FROM zinc_susp_drugs

ahfs_codes AS (

  CASE WHEN t.total_textbook_refs > a.unique_ahfs_codes THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS textbook_refs_greater,

FROM textbook_refs t
CROSS JOIN ahfs_codes a
